observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Urban street with graffiti-covered wall, public performance.
observation.dancers: 7 people: 5 men playing drums, 1 woman dancing, 1 man dancing with a cane.
observation.formation_and_space: The drummers are in a line against the wall; the dancers move in front of them.
observation.posture: Upright torso, knees slightly bent, weight shifts between feet.
observation.footwork: Small, rhythmic steps, often on the balls of the feet, keeping time with the drum beat.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms move rhythmically, often bent at the elbows; the man with the cane uses it as a prop.
observation.hips_and_torso: Subtle hip movements and torso swaying in time with the music.
observation.partnering: None; the dancers interact with the drummers and the space.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Mostly at one level, with small, quick steps and occasional turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Drummers wear white shirts and ties; one dancer wears a white top and black pants, the other a suit with a top hat and cane; one woman in the background wears a traditional white dress.
observation.cannot_infer: The video is low-resolution, making it difficult to see precise footwork or weight transfer.

signature_moments.what: The man with the cane performs a rhythmic step while moving his cane in time with the music.
The woman performs a series of small, rhythmic steps while moving her arms.
The man with the cane performs a series of rhythmic steps, emphasizing the beat with his cane.
